root_cause.text: The `rzn1_dmamux_route_allocate` function in the RZN1 DMA router driver fails to decrement the reference count of the DMA master OF node (`dma_spec->np`) when route allocation fails due to a busy channel.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that when `test_and_set_bit` fails, the error path previously jumped directly to `free_map`, bypassing the cleanup of the OF node. The patch fixes this by introducing the `put_dma_spec_np` label, which calls `of_node_put(dma_spec->np)`, and updating the error jump to target this new label.
